title: The functional mechanisms of synchronizing royal jelly consumption and physical activity on rat with multiple sclerosis-like behaviors hallmarks based on bioinformatics analysis, and experimental survey.
authors: Lohrasbi, Maryam; Taghian, Farzaneh; Jalali Dehkordi, Khosro; Hosseini, Seyed Ali
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜂王浆与运动对多发性硬化大鼠模型的神经保护机制，涉及生物信息学与分子对接，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Natural nutrition and physical training have been defined as non-pharmacochemical complementary and alternative medicines to prevent and treat various pathogenesis. Royal jelly possesses various pharmacological properties and is an effective therapeutic supplement for halting neurodegeneration. Multiple sclerosis is a prevalent neurodegenerative disorder that manifests as a progressive neurological condition. Inflammation, hypoxia, and oxidative stress have been identified as significant hallmarks of multiple sclerosis pathology. RESULTS: In the present study, based on artificial intelligence and bioinformatics algorithms, we marked hub genes, molecular signaling pathways, and molecular regulators such as non-coding RNAs involved in multiple sclerosis. Also, microRNAs as regulators can affect gene expression in many processes. Numerous pathomechanisms, including immunodeficiency, hypoxia, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction, can play a significant role in the MSc pathogenesis that results in demyelination. Furthermore, we computed the binding affinity of bioactive compounds presented in Royal Jelly on macromolecules surfaces. Also, we predicted the alignment score of bioactive compounds over the pharmacophore model of candidate protein as a novel therapeutic approach. Based on the q-RT-PCR analysis, the expression of the Dnajb1/Dnajb1/Foxp1/Tnfsf14 and Hspa4 networks as well as miR-34a-5p and miR155-3p were regulated by the interaction of exercise training and 100 mg/kg Royal Jelly (ET-100RJ). Interestingly, characteristics, motor function, a proinflammatory cytokine, and demyelination were ameliorated by ET-100RJ. DISCUSSION: Here, we indicated that interaction between exercise training and 100 mg/kg Royal jelly had a more effect on regulating the microRNA profiles and hub genes in rats with Multiple sclerosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：天然营养与体育锻炼已被定义为非药物化学的补充与替代医学，用于预防和治疗多种病理过程。蜂王浆具有多种药理特性，是阻止神经退行性变的有效治疗补充剂。多发性硬化症是一种常见的神经退行性疾病，表现为进行性神经系统状况。炎症、缺氧和氧化应激已被确定为多发性硬化症病理的重要标志。结果：在本研究中，基于人工智能和生物信息学算法，我们标记了参与多发性硬化症的枢纽基因、分子信号通路和分子调控因子，如非编码RNA。此外，作为调控因子的microRNA可在许多过程中影响基因表达。多种病理机制，包括免疫缺陷、缺氧、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍，可能在导致脱髓鞘的多发性硬化症发病机制中发挥重要作用。进一步地，我们计算了蜂王浆中生物活性化合物与大分子表面的结合亲和力。同时，我们预测了生物活性化合物在候选蛋白药效团模型上的比对分数，作为一种新型治疗方法。基于q-RT-PCR分析，Dnajb1/Dnajb1/Foxp1/Tnfsf14和Hspa4网络以及miR-34a-5p和miR155-3p的表达受运动训练和100 mg/kg蜂王浆（ET-100RJ）相互作用的调控。有趣的是，ET-100RJ改善了特征、运动功能、促炎细胞因子和脱髓鞘状况。讨论：在此，我们表明，运动训练与100 mg/kg蜂王浆的相互作用在调节多发性硬化症大鼠的microRNA谱和枢纽基因方面具有更显著的效果。
